import subprocess

# Final verification of all requirements
print("=== FINAL VERIFICATION ===")

# 1. Check git log
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("\nCommits on top of base:")
print(result.stdout)
commit_count = len([l for l in result.stdout.strip().split('\n') if l])
print(f"Commit count: {commit_count}")

# 2. Run all tests
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-x', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', 
     'tests/test_cache.py', 'tests/test_cached.py', 'tests/test_cachedmethod.py',
     'tests/test_fifo.py', 'tests/test_func.py', 'tests/test_keys.py',
     'tests/test_lfu.py', 'tests/test_lru.py', 'tests/test_mru.py',
     'tests/test_rr.py', 'tests/test_tlru.py', 'tests/test_ttl.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120
)
for line in result.stdout.split('\n'):
    if 'passed' in line:
        print(f"\nTest result: {line}")

# 3. Verify public names
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', '''
from cachetools import cached, cachedmethod
from cachetools.func import lru_cache, ttl_cache, fifo_cache, lfu_cache, rr_cache
print("All public names accessible: OK")
'''], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"\nPublic names: {result.stdout.strip()}")

# 4. Verify no test files modified
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
modified = [f for f in result.stdout.strip().split('\n') if f]
print(f"\nModified files: {modified}")
has_tests = any('test' in f for f in modified)
print(f"Contains test files: {has_tests}")
